description: Provides an interactive HTML viewer with editable source, live rendering, and DOM inspection.

attributes.name: allow-script
attributes.description: Allows executable scripts in the rendered example.

attributes.name: lite
attributes.description: Uses the compact single-example viewer with rendered HTML output.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Viewer presentation: full controls, compact controls, or only source editor and rendered output.

attributes.name: no-loader
attributes.description: Disables automatic tp-loader injection when the example manages its own imports.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of the HTML file to load into the viewer.

methods.name: createRenderedDocument(): Promise<string>
methods.description: Creates an independent HTML document from the current source for testing.

methods.name: getValue(): string
methods.description: Returns the current editable source, including unsaved preview changes.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Restores the selected example and refreshes its preview.

methods.name: run(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Renders the edited source, unless the cancelable run event is handled by the parent.

methods.name: selectOutputMode(value: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Selects the rendered, generated HTML or structural output supported by this viewer.

methods.name: setSource(source: string, baseHref: string | null = null, resetSource = source): void
methods.description: Sets the HTML source from code.

methods.name: setValue(source: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Replaces the editable source and refreshes the preview without replacing the editor.

methods.name: toggleCode(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the source while retaining a visible panel.

methods.name: toggleEditorToolbar(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides toolbars on the currently visible editors.

methods.name: toggleOutput(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the output while retaining a visible panel.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-html-viewer>` element provides an interactive HTML viewer with editable source, live rendering, and DOM inspection.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Code | The viewer initially displays the result. **Code** shows or hides the source editor; edit the source there, then use **Run** to update the result. **Reset** restores the initial source. |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" size="1.25em"} Code | Shows or hides the source editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="1.25em"} Editor toolbar | Shows or hides the toolbar of every visible code editor. |
| :tp-icon:{name="eye-outline" size="1.25em"} Render | Shows or hides the rendered output. |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh" size="1.25em"} Reset | Restores the initially loaded content. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play" size="1.25em"} Run | Renders the current source. |
| Fullscreen / Exit fullscreen | Expand the entire component to fullscreen or return to its normal size. |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" size="2em"} Show code | Show code. |
| :tp-icon:{name="eye-outline" size="2em"} Show output | Show output. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="2em"} Toggle editor toolbar | Toggle editor toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="language-html" library="tp" size="2em"} Rendered HTML | Rendered HTML. |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" library="tp" size="2em"} Generated HTML | Generated HTML. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> | Run the current source from the viewer, including while editing code. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Esc</kbd> | Exit fullscreen. |
